summary: Public projects created on 25 February 2025: 2 repos.
intro: Two prompt collections for configuring large language models: a set of general system prompts intended to encourage neutral behaviour, and a user interface that combines model and user characteristics to generate more targeted prompts.

projects.name: General System Prompts
projects.description: Some system prompts intended to (attempt to) configure neutral behavior from LLMs

projects.name: System Prompt Factory
projects.description: A system prompt generation UI that combines model and user characteristics to generate more targeted (but still general) system prompts for LLMs
